wrap_environment_canonical_spec: wrap a dm_env environment with CanonicalSpecWrapper to normalize action specs to the range [-1, 1]
convert_bounded_spec_to_canonical: convert a BoundedArray action spec to canonical scale with minimum -1 and maximum 1 using _convert_spec
scale_action_to_original_range: scale a canonical action from [-1, 1] back to the original spec range using _scale_nested_action
step_with_canonical_actions: call step on CanonicalSpecWrapper with actions in [-1, 1] range and get a TimeStep from the wrapped environment
get_canonical_action_spec: call action_spec on CanonicalSpecWrapper to retrieve the normalized action spec with bounds set to [-1, 1]
